subject: Eval kickoff: success criteria & ownership matrix
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Leah Kim <leah.kim@datascape.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Eval kickoff: success criteria & ownership matrix

Hi Leah — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the evaluation moving: 

Summary of goals
- Primary goal: validate 95th-pctl latency < 350ms for 512-token requests at target concurrency (10 r/s) with no more than 15% token cost uplift vs baseline.
- Secondary goal: confirm inference integration pattern for our SDK and verify security posture (no customer data persists outside KV cache).

Proposed success criteria (attached template)
- Latency SLOs by endpoint (measurements + test harness)
- Throughput stability (sustained 60-minute run)
- App-level correctness: top-3 prompt suites meet acceptance pass-rate >= 90% (per your team’s validation sets)
- Security controls validated: SOC2 artifacts and network segmentation checks

High-level timeline
- Kickoff call: target week of Oct 18 (30–45m) — confirm availability
- Provisioning & infra handoff: provision Dedicated trial nodes within 5 business days after kickoff
- Smoke tests + first run: within 3 business days of provisioning
- Evaluation window: 2 weeks of steady-state testing

Ownership ask: please confirm the contacts below and add any missing folks:
- Datascape infra lead (provisioning + network): ???
- Datascape app owner (integration): ???
- Datascape procurement contact (PO / SOW): ???

Internal owners (proposed)
- AE / commercial: Ben Carter — contracting & timeline
- Solutions / integration: Karthik Iyer — onboarding & test harness
- Security & compliance: Soojin Lee — SOC2 scoping + evidence
- Customer success / health: Hannah Schmitt — acceptance & rollup

Attachments: eval-success-criteria-template.xlsx (fill and return; we’ll use during the kickoff)

Please reply with the infra/app/procurement contacts and if the timeline works. Once we have that I’ll send a calendar invite and a shared Doc with the RACI matrix.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

Our contacts

Acceptance criteria: the latency/throughput targets are reasonable. We’ll fill in the attached template and return it by Oct 15.

Leah

Thanks — tagging onto Kim’s note. Draft RACI (please confirm/adjust):

- Provisioning & network config
  Responsible: Marcus Cole (Datascape)
  Accountable: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) for providing deployment pack + infra guide
  Consulted: Soojin Lee (security)
  Informed: Ben Carter, Hannah Schmitt

- SDK integration & test harness
  Responsible: Tom Alvarez (Datascape), supported by Karthik Iyer (Redwood)
  Accountable: Tom Alvarez
  Consulted: Leah Kim
  Informed: Ben Carter

- Security scoping (SOC2 evidence, network segmentation)
  Responsible: Soojin Lee (Redwood) + Marcus Cole (Datascape) for environment details
  Accountable: Soojin Lee

- Contract / PO (procurement)
  Responsible: Angela White (Datascape)
  Accountable: Ben Carter (Redwood) to produce sample SOW & cost estimate

Action items I will own before kickoff:
- Draft deployment runbook and share by EOD Oct 14
- Provide a small load script and quickstart harness for the 512-token test

If Datascape can confirm Marcus/Tom/Angela are the right owners, I’ll incorporate them into the shared RACI doc.

—Karthik

Leah/Marcus — quick security checklist for the kickoff so we scope SOC2 artifacts correctly. Attached: security-eval-checklist.pdf. Please confirm whether the evaluation will run in your VPC peered with Redwood (preferred) or if you’ll provide a bastion host in your environment. 

Key asks
- Network diagram showing egress rules and any proxies
- Sample data classification for the test prompts
- Point of contact for audit evidence (who can pull SOC2 reports / controls)

If you can upload the network diagram to the shared Doc before the kickoff that’ll help us prepare the pre-checks.

—Soojin
